speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing swelling in your right knee and have a family history of similar issues. To begin my evaluation, can you tell me exactly how long you have had this swelling and if it was preceded by any injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Systemic/Juvenile-Onset).
Given the patient's age, onset without trauma, and strong familial history suggestive of a genetic predisposition, I need to rule out infection and assess inflammatory markers.

REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP, Rheumatoid Factor, ANA.
REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Knee_XRay_AP_Lateral.
